g.title: flashserver_gateway_flow
g.text: flashserver gateway and model scheduling flow
/v1 request → route / model selection → disk and capability gates → schedule → proxy / release

g.title: client
g.text: inference never touches a child endpoint

g.title: model
g.text: must be a full ref; body/query conflict → 400

g.title: placement
g.text: runtime cell: SM + CUDA + Python ABI
no GPU cell → CPU fallback (can be disabled)
slots/VRAM short → LRU evict idle or queue

g.title: proxy
g.text: strips auth / token / cookie; client close → cancel
rewrite SSE data lines; JSON ≤32MiB model

g.title: mgmt
g.text: Control plane is not the inference path
